title: Commutative algebras are ideals of evolution algebras
summary: We prove that every finite-dimensional commutative algebra can be embedded as an ideal of a finite-dimensional evolution algebra. We then determine the smallest possible dimension of an evolution algebra admitting such an embedding and study some structural properties preserved by the construction. Over fields of characteristic different from two, we relate this minimal dimension to simultaneous Waring decompositions of the quadratic map $x\mapsto x^2$.
